title: Check Git Sync status and resolve upload failures
text:
Breadcrumbs
Check
Git Sync
in
Version History
to see whether a Flow or Subflow version has uploaded to the mapped Git repository.
Check a version’s sync status
Open the Flow or Subflow.
Open
Version History
.
Review the
Git Sync
column.
Status
Meaning
What to do
Success
The version uploaded to the mapped repository.
No action is needed.
Error
The upload failed. Hover over the status to view the error.
Resolve the cause, then select
Sync
when available.
Warning
The version may be queued, processing, waiting for retry, or blocked by an earlier failure.
Wait if processing. If the warning remains, check for an earlier failed upload or ask an administrator to review the queue.
Deprecated
The version has no upload queue entry.
Contact an administrator if the version should be available from Git.
Resolve an upload failure
A failed upload does not delete the saved Leapwork version. Later versions of the same Flow or Subflow wait until the failed upload succeeds. Other assets can continue to synchronize.
Review the error shown when you hover over
Error
.
Check that the Controller can reach the Git provider over HTTPS.
Check that the Git connection, repository mapping, and required PATs are correct and current.
Check that the token identity has repository write access.
Resolve any provider approval or security block.
Select
Sync
from the Flows pane notification when available.
Refresh
Version History
and confirm that the status changes to
Success
.
A retry is available only for a failed queue item and requires the user to have the necessary edit permission.
Check migration status
Status
Meaning
Next step
Not Applicable
The team has no existing Flow or Subflow history to migrate.
Enable the mapping without migration.
Not Started
Existing history has not been migrated.
Run migration before enabling the mapping.
Migrating
Versions are transferring to the repository.
Wait. Do not create, save, import, or edit the team’s Flows or Subflows, and do not run preview runs.
Completed
The selected versions transferred successfully.
Verify a test save and its Git Sync status.
Partial
Some selected versions transferred and others did not.
Resolve the reported issue and retry where available.
Failed
Migration did not complete.
Resolve the reported issue and retry where available.
If the issue continues
Check the Controller’s connection to the provider, the selected Git provider and repository, PAT validity and permissions, and whether the repository’s branch rules allow Leapwork to write. For migration issues, also confirm that you are in the mapped team.
